response.justification: While Bogdan is a highly accomplished senior software engineer with 20 years of experience meeting the educational and seniority requirements, he lacks fundamental expertise required for this Principal Performance Architect role. The position demands deep knowledge of SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, and hardware-software co-design, but his background is entirely in application software development (web, mobile, backend systems). His optimization experience is software-focused, and his current AI work involves infrastructure tooling rather than accelerator hardware optimization. The domain expertise gap is too significant to bridge.
strengths: 20 years of software development experience meeting the minimum 8+ years with Bachelor's degree requirement
Demonstrated track record optimizing complex systems, including low-latency microservices handling millions of requests and pricing algorithm optimization
Current exposure to AI infrastructure through work on AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling at re:cinq
concerns: No SoC or IP modeling experience, which is a core responsibility and required technical skill for the role
No background in hardware architecture, GPU design, or accelerator optimization—entirely software-focused career path
Lacks hardware-software co-design expertise and performance analysis at the chip/architecture level, which are fundamental to the position
